SOR (Saturday Open Ride)

Fort Collins, CO · Road

SOR (Saturday Open Ride) is a road group ride in Fort Collins, CO. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Front Range Community College library parking lot (SW corner). Pace: b+ to A.

About the SOR (Saturday Open Ride) group ride

Fort Collins' standing Saturday road ride, with a course that changes weekly through the area's classic routes. Intermediate to advanced pace. Finish point changes with the route.
